bull_bear.body: Prioritizing deleveraging, synergy capture, and organic growth in companion animal; inorganic M&A under evaluation (small-to-mid deals in animal health, front-end distribution, or API capabilities); no dividend or buyback mentioned; ESOP cost to remain INR34-35cr annually for next 2-3 years
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Regulatory delays in CDMO filings; execution risk in integration; competition in animal health generics; U.S. tariff uncertainty (mitigated by U.S. manufacturing); ESOP dilution over next 2-3 years
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Highly confident, upbeat, and execution-focused; merger approval treated as a catalyst for transformation; synergy realization timeline (12-18 months) clearly articulated; strong emphasis on R&D and manufacturing integration; no hedging on guidance, projecting 20%+ margins as baseline
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Viyash’s CDMO pipeline (15+ products >$1B market value) is a hidden asset — revenue and margin inflection likely from FY28, not FY27; SeQuent’s API growth was held back by customer timing, not demand — visibility improves from Q4FY26; 7 backward-integrated products (formulation → API) are margin accretive and reduce third-party dependency
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Net debt to LTM EBITDA improved sharply to 0.4x in Q3 FY26 from 1.2x in Q3 FY25, driven by debt pay-down that also reduced finance costs.
- Management describes a strong balance sheet and market position as the foundation for capturing the market opportunity over the next 3-5 years.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body: Formulations: INR3,351cr (+18% YoY), led by Europe (+14%), emerging markets (+27%), India (+6%); API: INR830cr (+7% YoY), with new U.S. launch and FDA audit clearance; Viyash API/Intermediates: ~65-70% of its INR428cr revenue; CDMO: 15+ products >$1B market value, launches from FY28; Companion Animal: 4 new products developed, pipeline accelerating
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
- Formulation business is built on five pillars — geographic strength (EU GMP facilities in Europe; large US products relocated to low-cost India manufacturing; GMP facilities in Turkey/Brazil for emerging markets), established partnerships, a new product engine, growing companion-animal presence, and new market development.
- Combined API manufacturing network spans 10 facilities across Andhra Pradesh and Maharashtra with approvals from US FDA, EU GMP, WHO GMP, KFDA, ANVISA and PMDA.
- Signed an exclusive distribution agreement with Boehringer Ingelheim for companion animal products in India, and holds a leading position in segments like anesthetics in Europe.
- Sees two large strategic growth levers: animal-health generics (companion-animal generic penetration <15% vs 91% in human health and 70% in farm animals) and the API patent-cliff/CDMO opportunity.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

latest_quarter.body: Gross margin improved 270bps to 49.7% (SeQuent); EBITDA margin expanded 330bps to 15.5% (SeQuent); Viyash EBITDA margin 28.8%; combined EBITDA margin 22%; cost savings from: 6 intermediates moved internal, 3 sites rationalized, 7 products backward-integrated, supply chain consolidation
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: revenue growth: double-digit sustained; margin: 20%+ EBITDA sustainable by FY27; order inflow: strong CDMO pipeline (15+ products >$1B market value); capex/commissioning: INR60cr in Q2FY26 (Viyash); minimal capex in FY26; FY27 capex ~INR100-150cr for companion animal capacity
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: Companion animal formulations (global market tailwinds); CDMO revenue ramp from FY28 (15+ high-value products); vertical integration of 7+ key products into API; expansion into LatAm and Europe via Turkey site; potential in-licensing of animal health products
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: The NCLT-approved merger of SeQuent and Viyash has created an integrated life sciences player with immediate margin expansion (22% EBITDA) and a clear path to 20%+ sustainable margins, driven by synergies in R&D, manufacturing, and CDMO; what matters is the acceleration of companion animal formulations and API verticalization, positioning the combined entity as a global low-cost innovator in animal health.

open.item: Zoetis discontinued product (~INR12-14cr) expected to relaunch/return in FY26.
US FDA formulation project remains on hold; no acceleration expected in next 12-24 months.
Geopolitical raw-material/solvent/freight pressure since March 2026 (INR1-2cr Q4 freight hit); managed via inventory and price increases, no material impact expected near term.
Key focus on improving EBITDA-to-PAT conversion (Q4 EBITDA INR200cr vs PAT INR60cr) via lower finance cost and tax optimisation; further debt reduction.
FY27 is companion-animal platform-building: R&D expansion (5-6x product development, 7-8 products/year), manufacturing infrastructure, and BI distribution; first-phase Europe + India.
Goodwill/intangible amortisation (~INR100cr in FY26) drops to ~INR35cr in FY27, reducing the drag by ~INR65cr annually.
Investing in Spain manufacturing expansion, Turkey capacity debottlenecking, an oncology potent R&D lab (ready this/next quarter), and India companion-animal manufacturing.
API to return to double-digit growth next year (FY27) as intermediate optimisation ends and approvals/animal-health APIs ramp.
Innovator/life-cycle-management (CDMO) business (~INR200-225cr base) expected to grow ~40% in FY27.
Synergies tracking ~INR50-60cr annualized; total expected to rise to ~INR125-150cr annualized over next 12-18 months.
US formulation (Appco, 60% owned, ~INR400-425cr rev) and Spain (60% owned, ~INR550cr rev) minorities (~20% of PAT); Spain buyback option by ~2028, being evaluated over next 1-2 years.
Effective tax rate expected ~26-27% for FY27/FY28 (post shift from old to new tax regime).
Targeting ~INR1,000cr EBITDA (from INR700cr) over next ~2-3 years, with ~15% annual growth guidance.
Gross margin (~54-55%) expected to be maintained, with only +/-1-2% variation over next few years.
~15% (up to 15-20%) revenue growth considered achievable over next 5 years across formulation, API and CDMO; detailed strategy at a planned investor meet.
Carlyle (promoter, ~4-5 years invested) not looking to exit in the near future.
Typical 10-12% growth mix: ~4-5% price, ~4-5% volume, ~2-3% new products; new-product contribution being accelerated.
US BIOSECURE Act still awaiting Senate approval; management sees positive India shift regardless, but approval timing uncertain.
Turkey macro (currency/inflation) still not fully steady; requires agile quarter-to-quarter monitoring.
Actively evaluating disciplined inorganic/bolt-on acquisitions in companion-animal formulations and API intermediates.

verdicts.item: Management expects to move towards a mid-teen EBITDA (pre-ESOP) margin by the end of FY25.
Combined top line (~INR3,000cr+ today) heading toward ~INR4,000cr in next 2-2.5 years.
Effective tax rate expected in the 25-30% range going forward.
Amortization of acquisition intangibles (~INR100cr) to end in FY27; INR102cr exceptional (merger) items to go away in FY26.
verdicts.note: Intangible amortization stepping down (100cr FY26 to 35cr FY27, then gone); on track.

verdicts.item: Merger expected to close in 12-15 months, mostly by end of calendar 2025 (exchange approval advanced, then NCLT).
EBITDA-to-operating-cash-flow conversion has been low (~45%) for years due to receivables/inventory; to improve, next year substantially better.
verdicts.note: Receivables grew with revenue; EBITDA-to-PAT conversion still stated focus, days +5-6, 'in control'. [±10% rule]

verdicts.item: CCI, exchange and SEBI approvals obtained; NCLT-convened shareholders'/creditors' meeting set for Aug 30, 2025, keeping merger on the 12-15 month timeline.
PAT growth expected to run ahead of EBITDA growth for the year.
verdicts.note: PAT growth (1,324%) far ahead of EBITDA growth.

verdicts.item: SeQuent gross margin (currently ~48-49%) targeted to move toward 50% over coming quarters.
Companion animals (~5% of business) to be doubled over next 3 years organically, plus possible aggressive inorganic move.
verdicts.note: Companion-animal doubling reaffirmed, organic + inorganic options; no metric.

verdicts.item: Turkey (EU-GMP injectable plant) to accelerate exports into Europe, with a couple of launches for EU supply in next few quarters.
verdicts.note: Turkey injectables to Europe expanding; debottlenecking underway.

verdicts.item: Post-merger, to restructure/reduce high-interest SeQuent debt; evaluating clearing debt vs funding growth.
